newsitem.title: USA: North America bunkers mostly lower on cargo values.
newsitem.headline: North America bunkers mostly lower on cargo values.

text.p: North American bunker prices were mostly lower this week in moderate trade, taken down by weaker cargo prices despite good demand, players said on Thursday.
In the East Coast, New York Harbor prices fell about $5 from Thursday's levels to between $133 and $134 a tonne. 180 CST was also valued lower at $132/133, players said.
The harbor, which is still slightly tight in supply, helped to pressure down the Philadelphia and Norfolk ports. Norfolk 380 CST was at $125/127 with 180 CST at $130/133, East Coast players said.
